note: Observed incidence is aggregated from date_of_prodrome and used as the empirical proxy for SEIR E->I incidence. n_pop=188 is the documented susceptible population (Neal & Roberts 2004: Hagelloch had 577 total inhabitants, 188 children <=15 susceptible to measles, all 188 infected), NOT the full village population. A homogeneously-mixed SEIR needs an inflated effective R0 to reproduce this outbreak's speed since it lacks the household/school contact structure Neal & Roberts show is needed to properly explain this data; R0 estimates from this pipeline should be read accordingly.
